timing.formation_features: Known by the close of the source-timeframe impulse candle.
timing.touch_features: Known by touch_confirmed_at, one minute after the touch candle begins.
timing.forward_labels: Start at touch_confirmed_at and are never entry-time features.

rvol: Volume divided by the mean of the prior 20 observations in the same session-time slot; minimum 10.
swings: Pivot with 3 left and 3 right bars; BOS uses only pivots confirmed before the impulse bar.
structural_risk: Zone width plus 1 point; separate from SND's 100-point capped risk.
touch_episode: A continuous run of one-minute candles intersecting a still-active zone counts once.
forward_window: MFE/MAE and barrier labels use the first bars after the touch candle closes.
